title: Paul Scofield is an Enigma of Acting

commenti.body:
>In spite of that, I feel what makes Scofield an enigma is the fact that while great with stage acting, he did so little films and the fact is that he really didn't like the glamour that came with celebrities.

He's not the only one in this category: Sir Derek Jacobi and Sir Antony Sher are like that, too. As is Dame Gwyneth Jones and many others.
